name: i18n-infrastructure
goal: Create a bilingual (Vietnamese/English) i18n system with locale context provider, locale dictionaries, and a useTranslation hook
design_constraints: Cook confirms unit-test and quality-gate choices before each phase
No external i18n library — lightweight custom implementation using React context
Translation keys follow a flat dot-delimited convention (e.g. 'nav.home', 'auth.title')
All existing hardcoded English strings in COMMON_TEXT, UI_TEXT, AUTH_TEXT, STUDY_PACKS must be moved to locale files
Type-safe: locale dictionaries must satisfy a shared interface so missing keys cause TypeScript errors

steps.description: Create common/i18n/types.ts: export a Locale type ('en' | 'vi') and a LocaleDict interface containing every translation key used across the app. Keys should be organized by feature namespace: common.*, auth.*, nav.*, practice.*, progress.*, studyPack.*. All values are string.
success_criteria: LocaleDict interface covers every key from COMMON_TEXT, UI_TEXT, AUTH_TEXT, and STUDY_PACKS
Locale type is a union of 'en' | 'vi'

steps.description: Create common/i18n/en.ts: export a default English locale dictionary (satisfies LocaleDict) containing all current English strings migrated from constants.ts files. Values must exactly match the existing hardcoded strings.
success_criteria: All English strings match current hardcoded values exactly

steps.description: Create common/i18n/vi.ts: export a Vietnamese locale dictionary (satisfies LocaleDict). Translate all English strings to natural Vietnamese. Navigation labels, auth copy, practice UI text, progress labels, study pack descriptions — all translated.
success_criteria: All keys from en.ts are present in vi.ts with Vietnamese translations

steps.description: Create common/i18n/LocaleProvider.tsx: a 'use client' React context that manages current locale, reads from localStorage ('pte-practice-locale'), sets html lang attribute. Exports LocaleProvider and useLocale() hook returning { locale, setLocale, t } where t(key) returns the translated string. Also export useTranslation as alias.
success_criteria: LocaleProvider reads locale from localStorage with 'en' default
useLocale returns locale, setLocale, and t function
t function looks up key in current locale dictionary, falls back to English

steps.description: Create common/i18n/index.ts: barrel export for all i18n modules (types, LocaleProvider, useLocale, useTranslation, en, vi).
success_criteria: index.ts re-exports LocaleProvider, useLocale, useTranslation, Locale, LocaleDict

steps.description: Update app/layout.tsx to wrap children with LocaleProvider (inside ThemeProvider). Set html lang attribute dynamically or keep as 'en' default (LocaleProvider will update it client-side).
success_criteria: LocaleProvider wraps children in root layout
